svg.title: MuJoCo — thin-disc native parameter sweep
svg.desc: Native parameter sweep summary for the three thin discs gravity-settling benchmark.
svg.text: Three 202-mm × 4-mm analytic discs, 2-s gravity settling. Green = correct order and settled; amber = correct order but residual motion at 2 s; red = failure.
Primary sweep. solref time constant primarily controls compliance.
B. Softening contact raises peak overlap
Primary sweep; failure points remain shown to expose the boundary.
At the 1-ms setting, 0.5 is visibly under-damped; 2 settles fastest.
d0=dwidth=dmax was varied together; this is not only one scalar coefficient.

at dt=0.5 ms, stable solref values preserve order with nearly identical peak overlap across Euler, implicitfast and RK4. Newton averaged 1.3 iterations versus CG 13.9 in the solref=1-ms ablation; cost changes more than the trajectory.
Interpretation: first choose an adequate contact time scale, then use damping and impedance to manage ring-down. Solver/integrator are secondary in the tested stable region.
